review.note: Rejected as written. The gap (a Draft card for J10.3, E.1, E.2, E.4) is real, but this proposal does not close it and its expected result is wrong. Spec resubmission, not a defect. Follow the A2 review note: write the fixture (pkg-v3.json via sed from pkg-v1.json with a different fictional summary sentence) and the exact import command with expected output (resume_main #<new id> new_version, cover_letter #<id> unchanged); take the next unused precondition id (P.5) and state it runs after J9.3 and before J10.3; change E.3 so its re-import uses the latest imported file and still expects every output unchanged (or state E.3 runs before P.5); name the Draft card (the new Harbor Demo Resume).
